electronics_avg_price: SELECT AVG(price) AS category_avg_price FROM products WHERE category = 'electronics' AND price > 0
electronics_computers_accessories_produc: SELECT p.ref_id, p.price FROM products p WHERE p.category = 'electronics' AND p.ref_id IN (SELECT ref_id FROM categories WHERE cat_nm = 'Computers & Accessories' AND cat_lvl = 1) AND p.price > 0
electronics_computers_accessories_above_: SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p WHERE p.category = 'electronics' AND p.ref_id IN (SELECT ref_id FROM categories WHERE cat_nm = 'Computers & Accessories' AND cat_lvl = 1) AND p.price > 0) AS percentage_above_avg FROM products p WHERE p.category = 'electronics' AND p.ref_id IN (SELECT ref_id FROM categories WHERE cat_nm = 'Computers & Accessories' AND cat_lvl = 1) AND p.price > 0 AND p.price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products WHERE category = 'electronics' AND price > 0)
